title: Provisional investigation workflow
disclaimer: Hackathon demonstration only. This is not an official Karnataka Police procedure, standing order, legal checklist or departmental document format. Every step and draft requires review by the Investigating Officer and replacement or approval by the competent department before operational use.

baseSteps.title: Verify the saved case record
baseSteps.guidance: Review the FIR number, incident time, place, parties, allegations and jurisdiction recorded in the system. Correct source records rather than copying an error into later work.
baseSteps.rationale: Later tasks and drafts should use verified case data.

baseSteps.title: Identify time-sensitive material
baseSteps.guidance: Record which physical, digital or documentary material may be lost, overwritten or altered and note the officer-approved preservation action.
baseSteps.rationale: The system should expose a decision for the IO; it must not invent a seizure or preservation order.

baseSteps.title: Review parties and identifiers
baseSteps.guidance: Verify recorded complainant, victim, witness and accused details and mark uncertain identity matches as leads pending officer confirmation.
baseSteps.rationale: Name similarity alone is not proof of identity.

baseSteps.title: Record evidence collected and gaps
baseSteps.guidance: Compare the allegation with evidence and expert-result records. Document what is present, pending, unavailable or not applicable.
baseSteps.rationale: A visible evidence gap is safer than an unsupported conclusion.

baseSteps.title: Review database and linkage leads
baseSteps.guidance: Review similar cases, shared identifiers and network links. Confirm or reject each operationally relevant lead before relying on it.
baseSteps.rationale: Automated similarity and network results remain investigative leads.

baseSteps.title: Prepare an officer-reviewed progress update
baseSteps.guidance: Summarise completed work, unresolved tasks, evidence gaps and proposed next actions for supervisory review.
baseSteps.rationale: The IO remains responsible for accuracy and approval routing.

steps.title: Document the recorded entry method
steps.guidance: Review photographs, descriptions and evidence records concerning the alleged point and method of entry. Record missing documentation without assuming a method.
steps.rationale: Entry-method records may support later comparison when verified.

steps.title: Reconcile reported and recovered property
steps.guidance: Compare property descriptions, identifiers, estimated values, recovery records and seizure references already saved for the case.
steps.rationale: Property details should remain traceable to case records.

steps.title: Verify recorded vehicle identifiers
steps.guidance: Check that available registration, make, model, colour and other identifiers are recorded from a verified source before circulation or comparison.
steps.rationale: Incorrect identifiers can create false matches.

steps.title: Verify property identifiers and loss description
steps.guidance: Review descriptions, serial numbers, distinguishing marks and supporting ownership records saved in the case.
steps.rationale: Specific verified identifiers improve later recovery comparison.

documentTemplates.title: Record preservation request
documentTemplates.body:
DEMO DRAFT — NOT AN OFFICIAL DEPARTMENTAL FORMAT

To: $recipient
From: $officerName ($officerBadgeId), $stationName
Reference: $firNumber
Subject: Request to preserve identified records

Case context from verified records:
Crime type: $crimeType
Incident date: $incidentDate
Summary: $caseSummary

Records/material identified by the officer:
$recordsRequested

Officer-recorded reason and requested preservation period/action:
$reason

This draft must be checked, edited and issued only through an authorised departmental process.
